summary: Your business is highly exposed. A few targeted fixes would sharply reduce the chance of a costly incident.

dimensions.name: Network Security
dimensions.feedback: Basic perimeter and account protections are missing. These are the most common entry points for attackers.

dimensions.name: Employee Awareness
dimensions.feedback: Staff have little security training. Phishing remains the leading cause of breaches.

dimensions.name: Backup Redundancy
dimensions.feedback: Your business may not recover from ransomware or hardware failure. Backups are the last line of defence.
